About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Salesforce Developer at Anthropic, you will design, build, and maintain the Salesforce platform that powers our core customer motions and quote-to-cash business.: This includes automation throughout the Salesforce platform ranging from core sales automation to product catalog and pricing, quoting and approvals, order and contract management, and the handoff to billing and provisioning. You'll work both autonomously and collaboratively across RevOps, Order Management, Legal, Billing Engineering, Deal Desk, Finance and Accounting, and Product to translate pricing and packaging requirements into scalable Apex, Flow, and integration solutions, and to extend our capabilities with custom code where necessary. We are an AI-first systems team, and you'll be expected to use Claude and our in-house AI development tooling as a core part of how you write, review, and ship code, always against our house standards for flexibility, maintainability, and scale.

Where you might sit

We're hiring across more than one team. Placement depends on your background and where you can have the most impact.

GTM Systems: Builds and runs the Salesforce platform and connected tools that Anthropic's sellers, sales leaders, and revenue operations teams rely on every day. You'd build the automation behind how deals move through the pipeline, how leads and accounts reach the right owner, and how information flows between our sales tools and the rest of the business. You'll work directly with the analysts and operators who define the process, and see the impact on the people who use what you ship.

QTC Experiences: A vertically integrated team that spans quoting through to provisioning agreements, as well as customer billing experiences over the term of their agreement. You'd build the foundational systems for CPQ, order management, provisioning and billing experiences, envisioning how we make our sellers and ops teams orders of magnitude more efficient with Claude. You'll work cross-functionally with GTM, finance, accounting and other stakeholders. Your work will directly impact seller velocity and our GTM deal making capacity.

Key responsibilities

• Develop and maintain Apex (triggers, services, selectors, batch/queueable), Lightning Web Components, and Flow automation following our house Apex standards and trigger framework
• Design and build quote-to-cash infrastructure in Salesforce, including the product catalog and pricing data model, quote and order lifecycle, discount and approval automation, and amendment, renewal, and co-termination flows
• Extend CPQ and expand into agentic selling with custom pricing and quote-calculation logic, quote and order user experiences, and code built against the package's APIs and data model
• Build and own integrations between Salesforce and our billing, provisioning, and finance systems, such as Stripe, Metronome, and NetSuite, directly or via middleware
• Support new product and pricing launches by modeling catalog, SKU, and pricing changes so they can be released quickly and reflected consistently in every downstream system
• Use Claude and our internal AI development tooling as a first-class part of your build and code-review workflow
• Partner with Business Systems analysts and Finance to ensure data-model decisions support downstream bookings, forecasting, and revenue reporting
• Partner with DevOps on release management for your work: sandbox strategy, source control, peer review, and deployment via SFDX/metadata tooling
• Ensure appropriate controls, test coverage, and documentation are in place for an effective control environment, particularly around pricing, discounting, and contract changes
• Operate with ambiguity in a rapidly changing business, resolve problems independently, and propose solutions that scale

Minimum qualifications

• Hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, SOQL, LWC, Flow) in a production org
• Experience building or extending CPQ and quote-to-cash functionality in Salesforce (Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, Nue, or similar): product and pricing data models, quote and order lifecycle, approval automation, and amendments and renewals, including custom code written against the CPQ package rather than configuration alone
• Experience integrating Salesforce with billing, ERP, or provisioning systems via REST/Bulk APIs, middleware (Workato, Mulesoft, or similar), or direct callouts
• Fluency with SFDX, source-controlled metadata, and a sandbox-to-prod release process with peer review
• Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you write and review code, and the ability to speak to how you steer and verify their output
• Basic SQL skills and comfort working alongside a data warehouse
• Effective communication with sales, deal desk, finance and accounting, product, and engineering stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

• Salesforce Platform Developer I and II certifications
• Advanced Administrator or Application/System Architect certification
• Deep understanding of Salesforce platform constraints: governor limits, bulkification, sharing and visibility, recursion control, and how they surface in CPQ-specific situations such as large quotes, calculation performance, and bulk amendments
• Experience implementing a CPQ solution end to end or re-platforming from one CPQ to another, not just maintaining an existing one
• Experience with billing and finance platforms such as Stripe, Metronome, or Oracle, and with usage-based or consumption pricing models
• Working understanding of how CPQ design decisions flow through to bookings, invoicing, and revenue recognition
• Proven experience scaling Salesforce in a high-growth GTM environment

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$270,000—$315,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. jobs.description:
About the Team
DoorDash for Business provides meal solutions to our corporate clientele, but we aren’t stopping there. Our mission is to become the premier benefits partner for executives, employees, and administrators across the globe, leveraging the DoorDash platform to deliver industry-leading selection, quality, and customer service to every business customer for every business use case. We are building an entrepreneurial, customer-obsessed, and fast-moving team to create the right products and services for the future of work.
About the Role
As a Premium Resolution Partner, you’ll be the trusted point of contact for DoorDash for Business and Catering customers when the answer isn’t straightforward and the stakes are high. You’ll own complex customer issues from start to finish, working directly with customers across phone, video, and email to understand what happened, navigate the right path forward, and see the resolution through.
While our frontline Support teams are built to resolve issues in the moment, you’ll step in when a problem requires deeper investigation, cross-functional coordination, or ownership beyond a single interaction. You’ll have the autonomy and accountability to drive these issues forward—digging into our systems, bringing together the right partners, and staying with the customer until there’s a meaningful resolution.
Reporting to the Manager of Customer Operations, you’ll work closely with Account Management, Product, Strategy & Operations, and other teams across DoorDash. You’ll develop deep expertise in how our products and operations work, advocate for customers, and turn what you learn from individual cases into insights that improve the experience at scale.
This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role supporting some of DoorDash for Business’s largest and most sophisticated customers, including Fortune 1000 companies. As we grow the team from one to three, you’ll also help define how Premium Resolution works and what great looks like—creating an opportunity to build strong customer and business judgment quickly while growing alongside the function.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
You want real ownership
– You’ll take complex Business and Catering client issues from first signal through resolution, with the autonomy to drive the right outcome rather than simply handing problems off.
You’re energized by solving the hard problems
– You like getting beneath the surface, connecting the dots across systems and teams, and uncovering the root cause—not just treating the symptom.
You thrive when the path isn’t obvious
– You’re comfortable making thoughtful calls in fast-moving, high-stakes situations and have the judgment to balance customer needs, business impact, and operational realities.
You love becoming the expert
– You’ll build deep fluency in DoorDash’s products, systems, and operational tools, giving you the context to solve problems quickly and navigate complexity with confidence.
You want to be a true advocate for customers
– You’ll understand what’s at stake for the customer, take their experience personally, and work across DoorDash to get them to the best possible outcome.
You want your work to have impact beyond a single case
– You’ll spot patterns across customer experiences, translate them into actionable insights, and help influence the product and operational improvements that prevent the next issue from happening.
We’re excited about you because…
Bring 2+ years of experience in account management, customer support, retail, hospitality, or another customer-facing role, plus a college degree or equivalent experience.
Are a fast learner who can quickly become proficient in new systems, tools, and processes. Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft, or Google Workspace is a plus.
Exercise strong judgment — you know when to solve a problem independently, when to bring in the right partner, and how to keep things moving either way.
Are a clear, confident communicator who builds trust with customers and internal partners, even when conversations are difficult or the answer isn’t what someone hoped to hear.
Bring curiosity, humility, and a growth mindset — you ask thoughtful questions, seek out context, respond well to feedback, and are always looking to learn.
Are comfortable working in ambiguity and change, adapting quickly as priorities, processes, and the business evolve.
About DoorDash
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

(NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world. Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation. With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs. The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America. COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TECHNOLOGY OVERVIEW

KKR's Technology team is responsible for building and supporting the firm's technological foundation including a globally distributed infrastructure, information security, and the application and data platforms. The team drives a culture of technology excellence across the firm through efficient workflow automation, democratization of data through modern data and collaboration platforms, and more recently through research and development of Generative AI based tools and services. Technology is regarded as a key business enabler at KKR and is an important accelerator to drive towards global scale creation and business process transformation. The Technology team consists of highly technical and business-centric technologists with the ability to form strong partnerships across all of our businesses.

TEAM OVERVIEW

Our dedicated Product & Delivery function drives execution discipline across multiple technology teams with a goal to consistently deliver excellence serving our business needs. The Product & Delivery leads are responsible for defining the technology strategy, understanding the required capabilities, and delivery on the technology priorities for the business areas and functions they are partnered with.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking a Tech Product & Delivery Lead for Insurance Finance & Accounting to own the end-to-end strategy, roadmap, and delivery of technology solutions that power KKR's insurance finance and accounting operating model – from statutory and GAAP close, reinsurance accounting, and investment accounting through FP&A, regulatory and statutory reporting and finance operations. Reporting to the Head of Product & Delivery for insurance and partnering closely with the Chief Financial Officer, Chief Accounting Officer, and the broader Insurance Finance leadership team – as well as our Transformation and Insurance Engineering teams – this leader will shape the multi-year vision for Insurance Finance & Accounting technology and personally drive the most complex, highest-impact programs across the portfolio. The role acts as the senior bridge between Insurance Finance stakeholders and engineering, ensuring deep understanding of business priorities to drive the right prioritization, modernization, and AI-enabled transformation of how KKR closes its books, values and reports its liabilities, and meets regulatory reporting obligations globally.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Technology Strategy & Roadmap

• Define and own the multi-year technology strategy and roadmap for the end-to-end Insurance Finance & Accounting technology stack – spanning statutory and GAAP close, reinsurance accounting, investment accounting, regulatory and statutory reporting, and FP&A / finance operations – ensuring alignment with the firm's finance strategy and business priorities
• Drive prioritization and governance of the Insurance Finance & Accounting technology portfolio, balancing near-term operational needs (month-end and quarter-end close, statutory filing deadlines, and budget / planning cycles) with long-term platform modernization aligned to the CFO's, CAO’s and Insurance Finance leadership team's vision
• Stay current on emerging trends across insurance finance technology, actuarial and reserving platforms, regulatory reporting automation, and AI-driven finance solutions – bringing innovation into the roadmap and shaping the perspective of Insurance Finance leadership on where to invest

Stakeholder Partnership & Requirements Management

• Partner with the Chief Financial Officer, Chief Accounting Officer, Controllership, FP&A, Investment Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reinsurance, and Regulatory Reporting teams to understand business requirements and translate complex finance processes into practical, scalable technology solutions
• Collaborate closely with engineering leads to design scalable, secure, and efficient solutions supporting the full finance close-to-report cycle (e.g., general ledger and sub-ledger close, reinsurance accounting, investment accounting, regulatory and statutory filings, and management / board reporting)
• Serve as the senior technology partner to the Insurance Finance function, facilitating cross-functional collaboration across Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Technology, and building deep partnerships with business leaders globally

Technology Lifecycle & Delivery

• Lead standards for discovery, requirements management, delivery cadence, and adoption across the Insurance Finance & Accounting technology portfolio
• Oversee end-to-end product lifecycle for all Insurance Finance & Accounting platforms – including requirements gathering, vendor selection, solution design, configuration, testing, rollout, change management, adoption, and continuous improvement
• Drive the development and implementation of platforms supporting the full close-to-report lifecycle, including General Ledger / ERP, reinsurance accounting, investment accounting, regulatory and statutory reporting tools, and FP&A / planning and budgeting platforms
• Ensure Insurance Finance & Accounting technology solutions deliver an integrated, modern close and reporting experience, with workflow automation, self-service reporting, and real-time insights into financial, actuarial, and regulatory metrics
• Own delivery accountability for the portfolio – including budget, vendor relationships, SOWs, milestones, risks, and stakeholder communication – partnering with the Program Management function to ensure execution discipline across concurrent workstreams

Technology Innovation & Transformation

• Champion the modernization and automation of the Insurance Finance & Accounting technology stack, including cloud-native architecture, a consolidated financial data platform, modern integration patterns, and the application of advanced analytics and AI/ML to close, reporting, and planning use cases
• Evaluate and integrate best-of-breed Insurance Finance & Accounting technology solutions (e.g., general ledger / consolidation, reinsurance accounting, regulatory reporting, and FP&A platforms) as needed to enhance capabilities
• Lead the responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities across the finance lifecycle – for example, in automated reconciliations, anomaly detection in journal entries, close acceleration, and regulatory narrative and report drafting – with appropriate governance and human oversight
• Drive adoption of new solutions and embed them into the day-to-day workflows of finance, actuarial, and accounting teams, ensuring measurable impact and a best-in-class user experience

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure all Insurance Finance & Accounting technology platforms meet global regulatory expectations, including GAAP and statutory accounting principles, SOX, and NAIC and state Department of Insurance requirements, and internal governance standards specific to financial and regulatory data
• Partner with Legal, Compliance, Information Security, and Finance Operations to align solutions with enterprise risk management frameworks and to operationalize controls across the financial data lifecycle
• Implement controls, access models, and risk mitigation protocols aligned with enterprise technology policies, with particular attention to segregation of duties and confidentiality of financial and regulatory data

Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

• Monitor adoption and performance of deployed Insurance Finance & Accounting platforms, leveraging quantitative and qualitative feedback (finance, actuarial, and accounting users) to inform continuous enhancements
• Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system performance, user experience, process efficiency, and business value delivery across the Insurance Finance & Accounting technology portfolio
• Define, measure, and report on key product and delivery metrics – including adoption, cycle time, NPS, days-to-close, reporting timeliness, and ROI – to Insurance Finance leadership and the Technology leadership team

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

• 12+ years of experience in system implementations, product management, technology delivery, or transformation roles, with meaningful time spent leading Insurance Finance & Accounting technology programs, ideally within financial services, insurance, or large enterprise environments
• Proven track record of building and leading product and delivery teams, and of personally delivering enterprise finance technology programs at scale across multiple geographies
• Experience partnering with engineering teams, vendors, and systems integrators, and leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed environment with executive stakeholders

Domain Expertise:

• Deep understanding of the end-to-end close-to-report cycle and the operating model of a modern insurance finance function – including statutory and GAAP close, reinsurance accounting, investment accounting, regulatory and statutory reporting, FP&A, and finance shared services
• Hands-on familiarity with leading Insurance Finance & Accounting technology platforms across the stack – for example, SAP, PeopleSoft for GL/ERP; OneStream, HFM, or Anaplan for consolidation and planning; Clearwater Analytics for investment accounting; and reinsurance administration and regulatory filing systems as applicable to the specific insurance business – as well as experience with custom, in-house-built finance and FP&A platforms (e.g., built on Snowflake, Python, and React), not solely off-the-shelf/SaaS implementations
• Knowledge of GAAP, statutory accounting principles, and NAIC / state insurance regulatory requirements and their implications on finance technology and data architecture
• Prior experience with, or understanding of, financial modeling and forecasting, planning, and scenario / sensitivity analysis is a plus

Technical Knowledge:

• Technical fluency with enterprise finance and accounting platforms (both off-the-shelf/SaaS and custom, in-house-built), identity and access management, data governance, workflow automation, and emerging AI/ML tools applied to finance, actuarial, and accounting use cases
• Experience designing and implementing workflow automation platforms, integration architectures (APIs, event streams, iPaaS), and finance / actuarial data models across multiple best-of-breed vendor systems
• Familiarity with cloud data platforms and modern application stacks (e.g., Snowflake, Python, and React) and analytics/BI tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Sigma, Tableau, or equivalent), and with building or supporting a custom-engineered financial data and analytics layer on top of operational finance and actuarial systems – not solely a vendor-configured EPM/BI layer
• Understanding of enterprise DevOps, CI/CD practices, and modern SDLC frameworks, and how they apply both in a configuration-heavy SaaS finance / EPM environment and in a custom software engineering environment building proprietary finance and FP&A applications

COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Strategic Mindset:

• Ability to design and communicate a long-term vision for the Insurance Finance & Accounting technology stack while delivering incremental business value each cycle
• Strategic thinking with the ability to align product and delivery initiatives with broader enterprise technology vision, the firm's finance strategy, and business objectives

Stakeholder Management:

• Strong ability to engage, influence, and align diverse stakeholders across Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Technology functions globally
• Excellent articulation and executive presence to engage the CFO, CAO, Insurance Finance leadership, and Technology leadership, as well as to coach and mentor product and delivery teams
• Ability to build consensus and drive execution in a complex, fast-moving, and highly confidential environment

Execution Discipline:

• Skilled at prioritization, governance, and managing delivery timelines across a multi-workstream portfolio without compromising quality
• Strong program management capabilities to drive execution discipline across multiple technology teams, vendors, and concurrent finance calendar events (e.g., month-end/quarter-end close, statutory filings, budget and planning cycles)

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

• Strong skills in problem-solving, data analysis, and translating insights into product and delivery decisions
• Ability to balance technical feasibility, vendor capabilities, business needs, and end-user experience across finance and accounting practitioners

Change Leadership:

• Able to drive adoption of new solutions and embed them into business and finance processes, including the change management required for global Insurance Finance & Accounting rollouts
• Passion for innovation and for driving transformational change in how Insurance Finance & Accounting operates – with empathy for the close and reporting experience

Communication:

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences, including senior finance and business leaders
• Strong collaboration skills to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams and to lead distributed product and delivery teams

Note: Text highlighted in yellow reflects new or revised language addressing FP&A domain depth, custom in-house technology experience (vs. pure SaaS/COTS), and the added level and reporting line. Please review and confirm before finalizing.

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Accounting, Finance, or Actuarial Science, or a related field; MBA, CPA, or FSA preferred
